findings: Unused-phase penalty concentrates after the last trained step 40 (steps 41-44: 19.6, 24.1, 29.0, 34.1 percent mean snapshot nRMSE for PA<70 cases); interior unused steps add about +1.0 pp.
Phase input is sin/cos of cumulative mechanical angle; electrical periodicity is not encoded.
All 7 hard dev geometries have PhaseAdvance 74.5-86.4 deg (pooled all45 vector 28.7-39.0 percent) versus 16.8-23.4 percent for PA<=69.1 deg; 72 of 328 train conditions have PA>=70.
Copper meanB2 bias is -9.97 percent at seen9 and -9.33 percent at unused36, so it is not a phase-coverage effect.

decision.first_experiment: L12 arm A1: same architecture, same train328 split, same optimizer updates, training phases 9 -> 45. Compared against A0 (phase9).
decision.second_single_axis_candidate: L12 arm A2: phase9 data, phase input replaced by electrical-angle periodic sin/cos. Requires native confirmation of the electrical-cycle angle span before launch. Compared against A0 only.
decision.deferred: High phase-advance regime improvement (capacity, region-balanced loss, global context) and B2 loss are later single-axis steps.
decision.release: Contract only. Any GPU run needs the user's approval of the concrete bounded contract.

preregistered_predictions.P1: A1 improvement concentrates at steps 41-44 and 1-3.
preregistered_predictions.P2: seen9 and interior unused steps change by about 1 pp or less.
preregistered_predictions.P3: Copper meanB2 signed bias stays in -9 to -10 percent.
